frame_preflight.scope: Conservative component-bounds framing only, not visibility or collision

views.assessment: Pass. Complete localized panel and supporting upper receiver read clearly at1.65m camera height. Broad white/bluegrey fields, two distinct impact bands and three distinct sloped controls create organized staff character. The unchanged fixture is visibly held by its top plates/drop supports; no copied whole corridor or false lift enclosure.

views.assessment: Pass as disclosed intentional construction crop. Separate actual control surfaces, cover fasteners, hatch perimeter, upper gussets and fixture anchors are legible. The shortened hatch has visible separation from the fixture guard. No z-fighting or unsupported floating mount is visible. Floor/base are intentionally outside the detail view.

views.assessment: Pass. Complete fixed work/retrieval edge is legible at1.65m camera height. Shaped folded end supports, protected noses and contrasting work/shelf surfaces carry function. Lower retrieval and front toe spaces visibly remain open. No moving-cart claim.

camera.purpose: Lower service viewpoint exposes actual retrieval mouth, fixed tray support and deliberate corner protection termination; no actor/cart fit

frame_preflight.scope: Conservative component-bounds framing only, not visibility or collision

views.assessment: Pass. Lower service view shows real tray-bearing contact, open retrieval mouth, continuous shaped end-frame load path and deliberately terminated impact guards. Broad practical materials remain neutral; no global yellow cast.

reference_interpretation: Economical washable broad surfaces, organized supports/services and protected touch/impact edges. Reference narrowness and ceiling heights are not copied. The bounded catalogue component heights do not establish host headroom.
limitations: Eevee studio noise remains faintly visible in detail shadows but does not obscure supports or material boundaries. No game renderer, CRT, lighting performance or photometric claim.
Reused AST-STF-006 remains QA context only and is not a new design.
Collision compounds remain structural proposals; omitted small control/hardware detail and finite approximation limits are disclosed separately.
